description:
Fetch the complete Companies House charge history for a company.

Returns every registered charge (secured debt) — current and
historic — with status, dates, secured parties, and what each
charge covers (fixed/floating/negative-pledge flags and any
free-text particulars). Satisfaction is represented as
satisfied_on plus a charge-satisfaction filing entry, not a
separate 'release' record. company_profile.has_charges is a
True/False/unknown summary derived from this same data; use this
tool when the specific charges matter, not just whether any exist.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8 digits, e.g. '03782379'). Returned by company_search.

name: company_charges

outputSchema.description: Complete charge history for a company.

items.description:
A single Companies House charge (secured debt registration).

Satisfaction is represented via satisfied_on and a transactions[]
entry with filing_type == 'charge-satisfaction' — there is no
separate 'release' concept upstream, so none is invented here.

charge_code.description: Human-readable charge ID (e.g. '063334690005'). Absent on some older charges (e.g. pre-2006 debentures) — use charge_number as the reliable identifier.

charge_number.description: Sequential charge number for this company. Always present, unlike charge_code.

type.description: Classification type as returned by CH (e.g. 'charge-description').

created_on.description: Date the charge was created (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

delivered_on.description: Date the charge was delivered/registered (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

links.description: Upstream relational links, e.g. links.self = charge record path.

anyOf.description:
What a charge covers — free text and/or boolean flags.

Field presence varies by charge age/type: pre-2006 debentures often
carry only type/description with no boolean flags; MR01-style charges
(2013+) often carry only the boolean flags with no free text. Every
field is optional — do not assume any subset is always present.

contains_fixed_charge.description: True if the charge includes a fixed charge.

contains_floating_charge.description: True if the charge includes a floating charge.

contains_negative_pledge.description: True if the charge includes a negative pledge (restricting further charges).

description.description: Free-text description of what the charge covers, where filed.

floating_charge_covers_all.description: True if the floating charge covers the whole undertaking/all assets.

type.description: Particulars entry type as returned by CH (e.g. 'brief-description', 'short-particulars').

particulars.description: What the charge covers — free text and/or boolean flags, depending on charge age/type.

persons_entitled.description: Secured parties named on this charge.

items.description: A secured party named on a charge.

name.description: Name of the person or entity entitled under this charge, as filed.

satisfied_on.description: Date the charge was satisfied, or null if still live.

anyOf.description:
Free-text 'amount secured' description.

Seen only on older/pre-2006 charge filings — absent on newer
MR01-style charges, which express scope entirely through
ChargeParticulars' boolean flags instead. Optional, not assume-present.

description.description: Free-text description of the amount/obligation secured.

type.description: Secured-details entry type as returned by CH (e.g. 'amount-secured').

secured_details.description: Free-text amount-secured description. Present only on some older charges.

transactions.description: Filing events against this charge — creation, satisfaction, etc. Satisfaction is represented here (filing_type='charge-satisfaction') and via satisfied_on, not a separate 'release' concept.

items.description: A filing event against a charge (creation, satisfaction, etc.).

delivered_on.description: Date this filing was delivered (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

links.description: Upstream relational links, e.g. links.filing = filing-history path.

part_satisfied_count.description: Upstream count of part-satisfied charges, or null if not provided.

satisfied_count.description: Upstream count of satisfied charges, or null if not provided.

unfiltered_count.description: Upstream unfiltered charge count, or null if not provided.

title: Get Company Charges
